name: synkrisis
description: Checked cohort construction, bounded diagnosis, fixed-template rendering and whole-path verification over validated run observations, held to a measured work budget.

interface.shortDescription: Checked cohort construction, bounded diagnosis, fixed-template rendering and whole-path verification over validated run observations, held to a measured work budget.
interface.longDescription: Synkrisis compares validated Promise Machine run observations under an operator-declared policy. Its four operations build a checked cohort, apply a digest-bound deterministic rule catalogue, render a fixed report, and recompute the path from the original inputs under a recorded work budget. Excluded and unknown runs, counterevidence, and refused rules remain visible. A finding is a bounded inference and suggested hand-off; it never states cause, judges model quality, files an issue, edits a repository, or dispatches another skill. The two current rule kinds have only been exercised on constructed records, not a captured production cohort.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $synkrisis to build one checked cohort from declared run observations, diagnose it against the committed rule catalogue, and verify the report recomputes.
